primitive.relation: the complete multipartite graph with k parts of size m on the product carrier 'I_k * 'I_m (parts first): Chromatic U4 cmp_rel/complete_multipartite and X218 x218_multipartite_rel/x218_complete_multipartite are GTBase.complete_multipartite_graphs.complete_multipartite_rel/complete_multipartite_graph, the relation x.1 != y.1 by conversion and each graph pointwise and by the identity isomorphism. The four constructor proofs are related through the graphs they build (eq_diso), never by proof-field equality. Every k and m is allowed (k = 0 or m = 0 empty, k = 1 edgeless, m = 1 complete); 'K_k and 'K_n,m live on other carriers and are related by isomorphisms only.
